label: D2 after choosing a1, with a1-leaning policy readout (strongest on rare a1->S2 after an unrewarded trial)
explanation: Fires only at D2 (never D1/GO), almost exclusively after the agent chose a1 (99.3% of mass; a2 trials near zero). Within a1 D2 steps it fires when the model policy readout at that step is moderately pro-a1 (choice logit roughly 3-8); predicate (D2 & action==1 & choice>3) gives dev F1 0.79, mass recall 0.84. Magnitude: largest (0.8-1.0 of max) on a rare a1->S2 transition, especially when the previous trial was unrewarded (D2 & a1 & S2 & prev_reward==0: precision 0.84, 64% of mass); a1->S1 common steps get weak activations (~0.1-0.2), mostly when the previous trial was unrewarded. Rewarded-previous-trial a1->S1c steps are mostly silent. Simpler observed-only predicate D2 & a1 & prev_reward==0 gives F1 0.64. Does not fire on a2 trials or on any non-D2 step. No future variables used; choice is the model own policy output at the current step.
